datasets.title: Heat by country
datasets.description: Each country's 2025 temperature against its 1991–2020 average (ERA5 via Our World in Data), days above 35°C in 2025 and the 1991–2020 average (ERA5 via the World Bank), and modelled days above 35°C for 1995–2014 and 2040–2059 (CMIP6, SSP2-4.5).

datasets.title: Global temperature since 1850
datasets.description: HadCRUT5 annual global temperature, 1850 to 2025, rebased to the 1850–1900 average, with its 95% uncertainty range.

datasets.title: Global temperature by year, ERA5
datasets.description: Annual average of the daily global temperature and its difference from 1991–2020, 1940 to 2026 (2026 so far).

datasets.title: Daily global temperature since 2023
datasets.description: Daily global air temperature, the 1991–2020 average for that day and the difference, 1 January 2023 to 4 November 2026 (ERA5, Copernicus Climate Pulse).

datasets.title: UK summer temperature since 1884
datasets.description: UK average daily mean temperature for June to August, and for the year, 1884 to 2026 (Met Office HadUK-Grid). 2026 is provisional.

datasets.title: Map classes
datasets.description: Bands used to colour the three maps.

datasets.title: Headline findings
datasets.description: Published figures from Copernicus, ECMWF, the WMO, the Lancet Countdown, the ILO, ISGlobal, the Met Office and UKHSA.
